channel.title: The Catholic Review - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Catholic Review (catholicreview.org)

item.title: Report: U.S. fueling human rights violations with ‘externalized migration’ policies
item.description: The "externalization" of migration in the Latin American region -- particularly under the Trump administration's hardline policies -- is accelerating human rights violations while eroding human dignity, according to a new report.

item.title: ‘Rebirth’ art project offers counternarrative for Father Rupnik accusers, abuse survivors
item.description: A major new artwork dedicated to the victims of spiritual and sexual abuse in the church is to be displayed at locations where disgraced priest artist Father Marko Rupnik's mosaics are still exhibited.

item.title: Pope Leo XIV meets with evacuated Tehran cardinal as U.S.-Israeli strikes on Iran continue
item.description: Pope Leo XIV met privately March 11 with the cardinal archbishop of Tehran after the Belgian-born prelate was evacuated from Iran amid U.S. and Israeli military strikes on the country.

item.title: Deacon Stretmater, father of 11 who ministered at Howard County parish, dies at 101
item.description: The word “presence” defined the way Deacon Daniel Stretmater ministered, living a life to evoke Christ’s presence through everything he did in his 101 years of life, including actively serving for a quarter-century at St. Louis in Clarksville.

item.title: U.S.-Israeli war on Iran is failing the Church’s just war test, bishops warn
item.description: Since the start of the U.S. and Israel's war on Iran, some U.S. Catholic bishops have highlighted Church teaching on what constitutes a "just war" -- with one cardinal flatly declaring the current conflict fails to meet the necessary criteria, and is therefore "morally illegitimate."

item.title: Pope Leo XIV names Augustinian prelate as new prefect of charity dicastery
item.description: Pope Leo XIV has named Spanish Augustinian Bishop Luis Marín de San Martín as the new prefect of the Dicastery for the Service of Charity, reassigning Cardinal Konrad Krajewski to serve as archbishop of his home diocese in his native Poland.

item.title: Pope Leo XIV points to St. Joseph as an example of the importance of ‘being present’
item.description: Pope Leo XIV has highlighted how St. Joseph, who is never directly quoted in the Bible, is an example for Christians of the importance of "being present."

item.title: Amid measles uptick, infectious diseases specialist says Church recommends vaccination
item.description: Amid a spike in measles cases in the U.S., an infectious diseases specialist, who is also a Catholic deacon, told OSV News that the Church "has recommended measles vaccination to safeguard the health of children and families."

item.title: Just war theory in the age of AI weapons and the ‘Department of War’
item.description: What does the Catholic Church have to say about war? How does the concept of a "just war" which has roots in St. Augustine's writings relate to modern warfare? And what does a discussion of the ethics of war look like with modern weaponry, including weapons made with artificial intelligence?

item.title: Father Norvel, first Black superior general for U.S. men’s religious community, dies at 90
item.description: Josephite Father William Norvel, a forceful voice for Black Catholic identity who spent more than six decades challenging the institutional church to live up to its claim of being universal, died March 8. He was 90.
